senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. wds.) hypocrite, flatterer; faithless, arbitrary, fickle.
units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:1">Esth. R. to I, 1</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 34:30">Job XXXIV, 30</cite>) <he>בשעה שהמלך ח׳ וכ׳</he> when a king is arbitrary and rules tyrannically &c.

<cite ref="Job 34:30">Ib.</cite> <he>שהיה ח׳ וכ׳</he> for he (Ahasverus) was arbitrary, for he put to death &c.—Pl. <he>חֲנֵפִים</he>, <he>חֲנֵפִין</he>, <he>חֲנֵי׳</he>. Tosef. Yoma V (IV), 12; <cite ref="Yoma 86b:17">Yoma 86ᵇ</cite> <he>מפרסמין את החנ׳ וכ׳</he> you may expose the hypocrites to prevent defamation of the divine Name.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 4:1">Koh. R. to IV, 1</cite> <he>חֲנֵיפֵי תורה</he> pretenders of scholarship.
<cite ref="Sotah 42a:4">Sot. 42ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tractate Derekh Eretz Rabbah 2:1">Treat. Der. Er. ch. II</cite>.
<cite ref="Tractate Derekh Eretz Rabbah 2:1">Ib.</cite> <he>חֲנֵפוֹת</he> (masc., v. <cite ref="M01882"><he>מָסוֹר</he></cite>); a. e.
